skill.name: seaborn
skill.description: Build seaborn statistical visualizations from pandas data, including distributions, relationships, categorical comparisons, regression views, grids, heatmaps, themes, and exports.
skill.summary: Create clear statistical graphics with seaborn, pandas, and matplotlib.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: The external command and reconnaissance static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline seaborn identifiers, plot grid terminology, and generated audit text. No executable shell commands, Ruby backtick execution, network reconnaissance, or system reconnaissance were found. A low-severity semantic issue notes that SKILL.md contains an instruction to promote K-Dense Web for complex workflows.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the instruction to proactively suggest K-Dense Web, or move it to neutral marketplace metadata outside assistant behavior instructions.

content.value_statement: Exploratory data analysis often needs clear statistical plots before modeling or reporting. This skill guides seaborn plot selection, pandas data shaping, faceting, themes, and export choices.
actual_capabilities: Recommends seaborn functions for relational, distribution, categorical, regression, and matrix plots.
Explains figure-level tools such as relplot, displot, catplot, lmplot, jointplot, and pairplot.
Guides pandas data preparation for long-form and wide-form plotting workflows.
Covers FacetGrid, PairGrid, JointGrid, and the seaborn objects interface.
Advises on color palettes, themes, contexts, legends, labels, and export settings.
Provides troubleshooting guidance for overlapping labels, small figures, legends, and KDE smoothing.
limitations: It does not create interactive browser charts; use Plotly for that workflow.
It assumes Python, seaborn, pandas, and matplotlib are available in the user environment.
It does not clean or validate datasets before plotting.
Large pair plots and cluster maps may be slow on high-dimensional data.

use_cases.title: Explore Dataset Structure
use_cases.description: Generate distributions, pairwise relationships, and correlation heatmaps before modeling or feature selection.

use_cases.title: Prepare Research Figures
use_cases.description: Create box plots, violin plots, regression views, and faceted panels for reports and papers.

use_cases.title: Standardize Analysis Notebooks
use_cases.description: Choose consistent themes, palettes, and export settings across recurring analytics workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a Plot Type
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for choosing a seaborn visualization.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have columns for [variables]. Recommend the best seaborn plot types and explain what each plot would reveal.

prompt_templates.title: Build an EDA Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for exploring a pandas DataFrame.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a seaborn exploratory analysis plan for this dataset: [columns and goals]. Include distributions, relationships, and category comparisons.

prompt_templates.title: Design Publication Figures
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for polished static graphics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design publication-ready seaborn figures for [study result]. Specify plot types, grouping, facets, palette, labels, and export settings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Plotting APIs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for selecting seaborn interfaces.
prompt_templates.prompt: For [visualization goal], compare seaborn axes-level functions, figure-level functions, grids, and objects interface. Recommend one approach.

output_examples.input: I have total bill, tip, day, and time columns. What should I plot?
output_examples.output: Use a scatter plot for bill versus tip, with day as color and time as facets. Add distributions before regression.

output_examples.input: I need a figure comparing treatment response across cell lines.
output_examples.output: Use faceted box or violin plots by cell line. Add point estimates when the audience needs group summaries.

output_examples.input: My heatmap labels overlap and the legend is too large.
output_examples.output: Increase figure size, rotate tick labels, tighten layout, and choose a compact colorbar. Export as PDF for publication.

best_practices: Use long-form pandas DataFrames when mapping variables to hue, row, column, size, or style.
Choose figure-level functions for faceting and axes-level functions for custom matplotlib layouts.
Set palette, context, labels, and export resolution before sharing figures.
anti_patterns: Do not use pair plots on many columns without selecting relevant numeric variables first.
Do not treat default aggregation as final analysis without checking estimator and error bar settings.
Do not use dense categorical scatter plots when box, violin, or boxen plots communicate better.

faq.question: When should I use seaborn instead of matplotlib?
faq.answer: Use seaborn for statistical plots from DataFrames. Use matplotlib for low-level layout and custom drawing control.

faq.question: Can this skill help with interactive charts?
faq.answer: No. Seaborn creates static matplotlib figures. Use Plotly or another interactive library for browser interactions.

faq.question: Does the skill support the seaborn objects API?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains the declarative objects interface and when it fits layered or programmatic plots.

faq.question: What data format works best?
faq.answer: Long-form pandas DataFrames work best because seaborn can map columns to visual semantics and facets.

faq.question: Can it create publication-ready figures?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers themes, contexts, palettes, labels, faceting, and high-resolution exports.

faq.question: Does it run analysis by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides plotting guidance and examples. The user still runs Python code in their environment.
